finding: In women with GDM, reduced weight gain during pregnancy is associated with small for gestational age neonates.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was predicted by previous C-section and mode of conception.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was significantly lower in neonates of mothers with poor rate of weight gain compared to those with normal weight gain.
